title: Oral vs. IV Vitamins
desc1: While oral supplements come in various forms like capsules, pills, and liquids, IV vitamins are administered directly into the bloodstream via a drip line. This direct route bypasses the digestive system, allowing for quicker and more efficient absorption of nutrients compared to oral supplements.
desc2: IV therapy addresses various health concerns, providing rapid relief from symptoms like headache, dehydration, and nausea.
